description: This is the main source file for an Android application that manages app shortcuts. It handles UI interactions, creation, enabling/disabling, and removal of dynamic shortcuts, as well as restoring shortcuts from previous sessions.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Main activity class for managing app shortcuts; handles UI events and shortcut operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up shortcut helper, and loads shortcuts.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the shortcut list when activity resumes.

methods.name: onAddPressed
methods.description: Handles the add button click to initiate adding a new website shortcut.

methods.name: addWebSite
methods.description: Prompts user to input a website URL and adds it as a shortcut.

methods.name: addUriAsync
methods.description: Adds a new website shortcut asynchronously.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Updates the adapter with the latest shortcuts.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles enable/disable and delete actions for shortcuts.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns a string describing the shortcut's type (Dynamic, Pinned, Disabled).
